I find the naming convention to be extremelly confusing. I've seen a ton of cases, of other users who have also been confused because of this - we can assume that this happens all the time, most people just don't report this problem, as they don't even realize, that it's a problem

this is a very subtle issue, and it should be fixed

**Rename "Release_Debug" to "Release"**
- these are builds of godot, which are shared around
- official godot builds use this
- the _debug is really confusing, usually it's standard to use "debug" or "release", not both
- seriously you have no idea how much that extra "_debug" throws you off, just call it debug

**Rename "Release" to "ExportTemplate"**
- has nothing to do with the editor itself
- actually removes the tools
- is only used to export games, that's it
- has an immediate clarity now
- confuses new users, who have no idea what this is actually supposed to do
- users assume that release_debug is heavier, so they do a release, which is plain wrong
- users are confused, when godot throws up some random message
- users get confused, they assume this is inconsistent behaviour
- users assume that there's something wrong with godot

i think that this is a very obvious change and it woud improve the overall clarity and the usability as a whole
